highlights.title: Nvidia Notifies Customers About AI-Related Price Hikes
highlights.description: Nvidia Corp.'s biggest customers have been told that the prices of servers containing its artificial intelligence chips are going up more than 15% in many cases with memory chip costs soaring. Bloomberg's Anthony Stephens breaks down what we know so far. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Shein targets $27 billion Hong Kong IPO — a fraction of its 2022 valuation
highlights.description: Shein is planning to raise up to $13.86 billion in Hong Kong dollars ($1.77 billion) in its initial public offering, according to a filing on Monday.

highlights.title: Stablecoin neobank Fasset lands $1 billion valuation as SBI backs its payments push
highlights.description: The firm raised $68 million as its revenue has grown six-fold as stablecoin payments and settlement expand, CEO Mohammad Raafi Hossain told CoinDesk.

highlights.title: How the War in Ukraine Changed Modern Warfare
highlights.description: Bloomberg Intelligence's Rod Turnbull discusses how Russia's invasion of Ukraine and the ongoing conflict has changed how countries conduct warfare. He talks about the impact of new technology, drones and artificial intelligence on the military. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: New Zealand Joins Global Push to Ban Under-16s From Social Media
highlights.description: New Zealand plans to ban under-16s from social media, joining a throng of countries worldwide seeking to limit online harm to children.

highlights.title: Crypto holds big weekly rally as Warsh’s Jackson Hole debut comes into focus
highlights.description: Bitcoin holds above $77,000 after a 21% week, with XRP up 46% over the same stretch. Asian stocks fell as Samsung and Alibaba slid.
